name: Sleepless

gist.Lunatic Cycle - New Moon: First equipment of the chain: discards a card each turn to search the next Moon.
gist.Lunatic Cycle - Crescent Moon: Needs a New Moon out. Its hero reshuffles cards whenever it acts.
gist.Lunatic Cycle - Half Moon: Needs a Crescent. Its hero cannot lose more than half its health to one hit.
gist.Lunatic Cycle - Gibbous Moon: Needs a Half Moon. Its hero ignores status effects.
gist.Lunatic Cycle - Full Moon: Needs a Gibbous. A very large Attack bonus.
gist.Lunatic Golem: Creature that hits harder for every different Moon on the board.
gist.Lunatic Hawk: Creature that gains abilities with each different Moon.
gist.Lunar Eclipse: Trap: gives up a Moon to cancel and delete a card you play.
gist.Tsu'Ki, the Lunatic Princess: Summons Lunatic creatures at any level; Moons on her are much cheaper.
gist.Shu'Chaku, the Blood Moon Projection: Returns artifacts to hand to discount the next one.
gist.Play Money: A big discount on one artifact.
gist.Cool Repair: Re-equips a Moon from the discard pile.
gist.Heavy Hit: The attack that the Full Moon makes lethal.

plan: Five Moons in a fixed order, each only playable while the one before it is on the board, each expensive. Dmitri spends the whole early game paying for them; with every phase the Golem and the Hawk grow, and at Full Moon the equipped hero cannot be stunned, cannot be one-shot and hits like a falling tower. The chain is equipment: break an early link and the later Moons cannot be replayed until it is rebuilt.

looks.early: A New Moon on Tsu'Ki and an empty purse.
looks.mid: Three phases out, a Golem counting them.
looks.late: Full Moon: one hero immune to statuses, swinging.

opening.tell: He has a single New Moon and no gold left.
opening.why: The cycle costs him four or five turns of gold; nothing defends his heroes meanwhile.

midgame.tell: Three different Moons are out and a Golem counts them.
midgame.why: Fire Bomb destroys every Moon at once and each needs the previous one to return; the Golem shrinks with them.

crisis.tell: Full Moon is up: that hero ignores stuns and freezes.
crisis.why: It is one attack a turn: Homerun! and Cloud in a Bottle, or Fire Bomb if you still hold it; a freeze no longer works.

endgame.tell: The Moons are broken and his gold is gone.
endgame.why: He cannot afford the cycle twice.

opening.board: Dmitri pays for a New Moon and yawns.

options.text: Keep Fire Bomb for three Moons

opening.board: He discards to search the Crescent.
Play Money makes the Half Moon cheap.

options.text: Yeet the New Moon under it

midgame.board: New, Crescent, Half; a Lunatic Golem.
Lunar Eclipse cancels your Fire Bomb at the cost of a Moon.

options.text: He lost a link anyway: Yeet the next

crisis.board: Full Moon on Tsu'Ki; Heavy Hit incoming.
The Hawk has gained its last ability.
Half Moon caps every hit you land on her.
